Sketch

Variation 06 of the phase 36 phone, and the first of the round-two four. Same data as ios-2, same components, a different direction: an artist's notebook that draws itself while you watch. Every rule, ring, box and curve on this page is an SVG stroke pushed off true by a displacement filter and drawn on with stroke-dasharray, so nothing appears — it gets drawn. Press Play and the Add flow runs. Tick a move and the pen makes the check, the ring closes and the streak catches. Toggle a food rule and you watch the pencil redraw the projection and re-letter the landing number.

The read
One digit in twenty-four characters, and it is 0: a blank page, third from the start, before a mark is made. Four M's, m · M · M · m, mirrored around a Q — an open notebook, two leaves either side of the gutter. Three v's in the tail: a v is what a pen check actually looks like, and there are exactly three moves left to close today. Two x's: the two days this week that got crossed out. And two B's with no H anywhere, which on a pencil box means a soft lead. This page is drawn with a 2B.
Mood
A notebook that draws itself while you watch.
Accent
Graphite. #4c5560 on cream, #cfd8e2 on the black notebook. It is the only colour that touches a stroke: every edge, ruler, ring, box, leader and curve is the pencil. Lime stays on the add control and nowhere else. The spectrum stays a word or a mark — it colours the filled part of a goal ruler and the state word beside a meal, never a surface.
Type
Two hands. Geist keeps every structural label at 11 / 13 / 15, and the numbers stay Geist Mono so they line up. Caveat does the annotations, the captions on the photographs, the tally beside the ring and the landing number, and it runs one rung larger than the Geist it sits next to — 15 / 21 / 34 — because handwriting reads smaller at the same size.
Density
The ruled line is 21 px, and every block sits on it. The left gutter is 34 px, which is where the annotations and the receipt live. A tick row is 44 px tall and the whole row is the target, which is the fix for the 21 pt box the owner could not hit.
Cards
There is no card. There is a leaf: paper at radius 21, faint 21 px rules across it, and one drawn edge that wobbles because a hand drew it. Nothing on a corner, nothing decorative, no shadow except under a photograph, which is a physical object and casts one.
Motion
One easing, cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), and a duration family of four doublings, one per M in the seed: 180, 360, 720, 1440 ms. Every stroke enters by drawing itself from one end to the other; every word enters by being scribbled in from below-left.
The idea
Nothing here fades in. Things get drawn. A leaf's edge draws when it scrolls into view. A goal ruler draws its baseline and then its filled length. A tick is a pen stroke going down and up, and the words behind it get a line ruled through them. And the projection is a pencil curve: change a food rule and you watch the same pencil go back over the paper and land on a different number, which is then re-lettered by hand.
01

Today, and the pen works

Tap any row. The pen draws a check into the box, rules a line through the words, closes the ring by the length of one move and raises today's box on the week strip. Close all five and the flame catches and the streak goes from 6 to 7. The two moves Apple Health closes by itself say so in the margin, with the hour the total landed.

02

Add, played

The complaint was the four seconds between “Sending” and nothing. Pick an input and press Play: the sheet runs the whole sequence at the speed the app will run it. Text types itself and Send lights. Voice draws a waveform and the transcript lands word by word. One photo is pasted in as a print and a pencil hatch sweeps it, then the callouts are written onto the plate one at a time in the same hand, then the meal card rises with the numbers counting up. Four photos are read in turn with a check drawn on each print. All four end at the same receipt, written in the margin, and the receipt always offers Undo.

03

The expectation, in pencil

The quick view after a meal or a tick: the day's calories against the target, protein, the structure of the day. Then the sentence and the curve. Switch a food rule or a habit off and the pencil goes back over the paper — the curve is redrawn from the left, the dashed band widens or tightens and the landing number is re-lettered by hand. The arithmetic is lib/projection.ts: grade-weighted effect × adherence × horizon, summed, clamped by MAX_CHANGE. Drag across the plot and the tooltip follows your finger.

Today Blood Body Plan

Drag across the plot. The card carries the date, the value, the unit and whether it is a draw or a projection, and it never claims a state word for a number nobody measured.

The arithmetic, printed

recomputed on every cross-out
Contribution Grade Adh. mg/dL
Total, clamped at 50 mg/dL

A and B count in full, C is halved, D and E never project. The band is the grade-weighted spread: an A contribution is allowed to be 30 % wrong, a B 40 %. The contributions add up because that is how the trials measured them, separately, and nobody has measured the combination.

04

Meals, pasted in

A meal is a photograph stuck to the page with a strip of tape and a caption written under it. Tap a row to open Edit and Delete — the two verbs that were out of reach. The detail keeps the print as its hero, the portion stepper, the ingredients with amounts, Fix results and the confirm that names every write it is about to undo.

06

The black notebook

The owner runs the phone in dark, so the direction has to hold there. The notebook goes black and the pencil goes white: #cfd8e2, which clears 4.5 : 1 on the leaf, and the tape darkens so it still reads as tape and not as a highlight. The prints stay white, because a print is a physical object and does not know what theme you are in. Lime survives on the add control. The toggle at the top right flips the whole document.

07

Motion, stated

One easing everywhere: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1). One duration family, four doublings: 180, 360, 720, 1440 ms. Everything with a stroke uses the same primitive — pathLength="1", dash 1, offset 1 → 0 — so the Swift build has one animation to write and then reuses it fifteen times.

08

Where the numbers and the pictures come from

Data. The same file as ios-2.html: 52 markers with a value, 7 off, TPO 320 IU/mL against normal 0–34, vitamin D 19 ng/mL against 40–60, ferritin 22 ng/mL, LDL 118 mg/dL against the 70–100 goal band, the Aug 1 2026 draw, a 6-day streak with 18 as the best run, three meals on Saturday Sep 5 totalling 1 497 kcal and 93 / 93 / 84 g, steps 10 935 against a 90-day mean of 11 062, exercise 43 min against 49, three strength sessions on file for the week. The projection is lib/projection.ts run in the browser on the seeded interventions: effect × grade weight (A and B 1, C 0.5, D and E 0) × adherence × min(1, horizon ÷ the paper's own duration), summed, clamped by MAX_CHANGE.ldl_cholesterol = 50, with the band from GRADE_SPREAD. The adherence figures are the ones on the Plan rows: psyllium 86 %, oats 64 %, olive oil 85 %, the walk 57 %, resistance 33 %, plant sterols 71 % if it were adopted.

The one number this page adds. LDL 118 mg/dL, the figure the phase 36 brief names as the starting point for “lands near 104”. The two dated draws already on file are 168 mg/dL on Dec 9 2025 and 131 mg/dL on Aug 1 2026; 118 is the Sep 1 2026 panel. Everything else is carried over unchanged.
